subject: note: The decision to end one’s life in old age as a consequence of a terminal diagnosis and intolerable physical suffering is a very different matter from a sudden violent act in a moment of manic exuberance. The self-slaughter of a betrayed lover is very different from the carefully planned insanity of a suicide bomber.

note: Any full understanding of suicide requires, at the very least, the cultivation of a much longer and broader view of suicidal behaviour across as wide a historical and cultural sweep as possible, along with the richest possible sociological data.
